sources.author: Causal banking proposal
sources.source_identity: Project derivation/design or identity-bound primary-source review
sources.version_date: 2026-10-17; underlying sources and inherited cutoff limits in primary review

local_copy.anchor: Target-dependent weights, shared-control decisions and threshold references

inspected_anchors: Seven stipulated exact law families; target influence derivative, overlap remainder, joint covariance, resource duality, threshold curvature, discrete nonidentification and sharp transport bounds.
Separate symbolic/moment/dual/witness verification; residual regression and corrected ratio have the same true target/IF but differ under fitted nuisance error.
supported_claims: Seven stipulated exact law families; target influence derivative, overlap remainder, joint covariance, resource duality, threshold curvature, discrete nonidentification and sharp transport bounds.
Separate symbolic/moment/dual/witness verification; residual regression and corrected ratio have the same true target/IF but differ under fitted nuisance error.
limitations: Author review, not independent scientific acceptance.
Stipulated exact finite laws and monetary amounts; no bank data, ROI observation or new upstream estimator run.
Selected primary paths and versions do not establish whole-package equivalence, complete dependency rights or statistical qualification.
The rdrobust revision uses an inherited UTC end-of-day query; strict Shanghai-cutoff identity is unresolved. Mutable Stata manual cutoff bytes remain unresolved.
Public/generated comparisons are proposed; new statistical qualification requires a frozen prospective protocol.
Rendered visual acceptance remains false; inherited image allowance is exhausted.
